subject: FinTech Ops pilot: billing qualification, unit-econ targets & credit extension request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodai.com>
To: Alexa Ruiz <alexa@fintechops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: FinTech Ops pilot: billing qualification, unit-econ targets & credit extension request

Hi Alexa — great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps on the topics we covered (billing and pilot credits):

1) Estimated request profile (your numbers):
- 1M requests/day peak for event enrichment (typical prompt ~75 tokens input + 50 tokens output)
- Batch offline scoring: ~500k calls/day at ~30 tokens each
- Rough monthly aggregate: ~1.8–2.4B tokens/month (range depends on sampling and dedup)

2) Unit economics target:
- You mentioned a target of ~$18–22 per 1M tokens for production (including baseline caching and quantized model).
- For the pilot we proposed a target ceiling of $35/1M tokens while we tune cache/batch settings.

3) Pilot credits:
- To cover initial ramp and allow us to tune the caching/batching, would you consider a 2–3 week trial with a Redwood trial credit top-up? Please confirm the target coverage (tokens or $) you need.

Attachments: I’m attaching a usage projection (usage_projection_finops.xlsx) and a draft pilot plan (pilot_plan_v2.pdf) with a proposed cadence for checkpoints.

Can you confirm the monthly token range we should size for the pilot (low / nominal / high) and whether procurement needs us to route any paperwork to procurement@fintechops.com? If you can share an internal budget range (monthly committed spend), I can give a tighter cost estimate and a credit figure to request from our finance team.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alexa Ruiz <alexa@fintechops.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodai.com>
Cc: FinTech Ops Procurement <procurement@fintechops.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 17:41:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: FinTech Ops pilot: billing qualification, unit-econ targets & credit extension request

Thanks Aditya — that summary is spot on. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Nominal pilot traffic: ~650M tokens/week (we expect a conservative 2-week ramp then a stable week at ~650M).
- High case (stress test): ~1.1B tokens/week.
- Target production $/1M tokens: our execs prefer a long-run goal of $20/1M tokens; for the pilot they can tolerate up to $40/1M while we optimize.

Procurement note: please send any pilot credit agreement or PO request to procurement@fintechops.com. They’ll need the credit amount expressed as a dollar cap and a short SOW.

For now we’d like to request a trial credit that covers approximately 2.5M tokens (we budget token requests in 1M increments) — effectively a ~2.5M token credit to give us headroom for initial testing and tuning. Let me know if that’s feasible and what the approval path looks like on Redwood’s side.

—Alexa Ruiz
Head of Platform Integrations | FinTech Ops
alexa@fintechops.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>
To: Alexa Ruiz <alexa@fintechops.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 19:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinTech Ops pilot: billing qualification, unit-econ targets & credit extension request

Alexa — thanks for the clarity. We can support a small credit for the pilot while you validate performance.

Decision (internal):
- Approve trial credit: $1,200 USD cap (~equivalent to ~3M tokens at our pilot rates).
- Duration: 21 days from first request served.
- Guardrails: Cardinal limits (hard cap) will be enforced; we will also enable prefix caching and a throttled burst policy to avoid runaway spend.

Sean — can you action the credit provisioning and add the hard cap to the FinTech Ops account? Please confirm once the credit is live so we can loop in procurement with a brief SOW and the DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodai.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodai.com>
To: Alexa Ruiz <alexa@fintechops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodai.com>, FinTech Ops Procurement <procurement@fintechops.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinTech Ops pilot: billing qualification, unit-econ targets & credit extension request

Great — thanks everyone. Quick operational notes and next steps: 

- Sean (cc) will provision the $1,200 trial credit and apply a 21-day expiration plus a hard token cap. He’ll reply here once live.
- I’ll send a 1-page SOW and a short pilot checklist to procurement@fintechops.com (DocuSign link included).
- Proposed checkpoint: 7 days after pilot start for a tech tuning call, and day 14 for cost/quality review (we’ll share updated token burn and revised $/1M estimate).

Alexa — can you confirm the desired pilot start date (we can auto-start when the credit is active or you can trigger the first API call)? Also confirm if you prefer the pilot credit as a dollar cap or token cap — Marissa set the $ cap, but we can mirror that as a token allowance in the account UI.

Attaching pilot_plan_v2.pdf again for visibility.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodai.com
